sentences.text:
Prayer:- Criminal Original Petition filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C., to quash the S.T.C.
 For Petitioner :Mr.A.Raman  ORDER

This petition has been filed by the petitioner seeking to quash the case in S.T.C.No.862 of 2014 pending on the file of the learned Judicial Magistrate No.II, Virudhunagar and quash the same which is filed under Sections 52 and 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
2.Registry had doubt about the maintainability of this petition on the ground of territorial jurisdiction.
But, the learned counsel for the petitioner has re-
submitted the petition stating that since, the part of the cause of action lies before the jurisdiction of this Court, this petition is maintainable.

Hence, on the orders of this Court, this petition is listed under the caption for maintainability.
3.I have heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and I have also perused the records carefully.
4.The learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that since, a part of the cause of action for the launching of the prosecution had arisen within the jurisdiction of the Principal Bench of this Court,
this Court has got jurisdiction.
In my considered opinion, it is not so.

The jurisdiction to transfer a Sr.D.Krishnamoorthy vs Food Safety Officer Ii on 31 October, 2014 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120460468/
1 case lies in the Court within whose territorial, the situs of the Court where the case is pending, is situated.

entities.text: Sr.D.Krishnamoorthy vs Food Safety Officer Ii
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The situs of the learned Judicial Magistrate is at Virudhunagar which falls within the territorial jurisdiction of the Madurai Bench of this Court.
Therefore, this petition cannot be maintained and the same is dismissed at the SR stage itself.
